What happens when cats start calling the shots at home? From unpredictable behaviour to everyday chaos, these cat owners are discovering that living with their feline companions isn't always as adorable as it seems.
Cat behaviourist Jackson Galaxy steps in to uncover what's driving these cats' troublesome behaviour. As he helps frustrated owners understand their pets better, the challenge is to restore harmony in households where the cats seem to be in charge.
Watch My Cat From Hell Season 3 Episodes 2, 3, 5 & 8 and Season 4 Episodes 7, 10 & 16 on AP to see how Jackson tackles feline chaos.
